description: Land Title Settlement Department - (Final Orders) - No. 111 (Kegalle) Dodawatta, Aluthgamkorale East DRO's Division Geraniyagala D/S Division, Kegalle
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land settlement matters under the Land Settlement Ordinance. It contains a final order amendment regarding specific land lots (118, 744, 745, 746, 747, 748) in Dodawatta village, Kegalle District, declaring that these lands have ceased to be subject to legal proceedings under the ordinance. The content focuses on land demarcation, settlement orders, and property status - all falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
